courses.title: Low Level Design
courses.description: Low level design is the breakdown of system requirements/specifications to object behaviours and relations. A typical 'LLD' of a system needs the following: 1) Setting the requirements 2) Identifying behaviours which can be encapsulated in objects. 3) Managing the state of these objects. 4) Planning for concurrency, fault tolerance and exceptions. 5) Building a test suite for the code. We will be touching on these topics in this series.
